sources: GeoTIFF rasters are delivered in 5km tiles aligned to OS National Grid.
Values are metres, referenced to Ordnance Datum Newlyn and using OSTN15 transformation.
Individual surveys entering the composite report +/-15cm RMSE vertical accuracy.
Metadata index catalogues identify which survey was used for a location.
Dataset states no public access constraints; licence is Open Government Licence.
Technical information states annual update frequency.
/vsicurl/ relies on HTTP range requests for piece-wise access to static remote datasets.
use_head controls whether an HTTP HEAD request may be emitted; default is yes.
max_retry overrides GDAL_HTTP_MAX_RETRY for a remote file.
retry_delay overrides GDAL_HTTP_RETRY_DELAY for a remote file.
VSI_CACHE can cache remote file content in RAM; default cache size is 25 MB per file.
VSI cache content is discarded when the file handle closes.
VSICurlClearCache or non-cached path configuration can prevent stale mutable-resource reuse.
VSIStatL reports remote object size in st_size when available.
list_dir and empty_dir control directory listing and probing for sidecar files.
/vsicurl/ supports header.<key>=<value> and bounded header_file handling.
GDAL_HTTP_MAX_RETRY defaults to 0 and bounds HTTP retry attempts.
GDAL_HTTP_RETRY_CODES controls which response/error cases are retryable.
GDAL_HTTP_HEADERS explicitly supplies request header key/value pairs.
GDAL documents gdal driver cog validate for checking whether a TIFF is a valid COG.
COG structural metadata can declare LAYOUT=IFDS_BEFORE_DATA.
GDAL COG layout places IFDs/tile indexes so a first 16 KB range request gets all IFDs.
COG tiles may be preceded by a 4-byte little-endian block-size leader.
COG structural layout includes a block trailer repeating the last four bytes.
COG structural metadata exposes KNOWN_INCOMPATIBLE_EDITION state.
COG structural metadata may identify mask data interleaved with imagery.
OVERVIEWS=AUTO may reuse or generate overviews; overview choice must not replace full-resolution terminal extrema.
OVERVIEW_RESAMPLING explicitly selects the algorithm used to generate overview pixels.
WARP_RESAMPLING controls reprojection resampling and can change pixel values.
GeoTIFF can contain an internal transparency mask with the same dimensions as the main image.
1-bit internal masks are normally exposed as 8-bit with unmasked pixels equal to 255.
SPARSE_OK may omit all-zero/nodata blocks and represent them with zero offsets/byte counts.
GDAL warns TIFF sparse files may not be readable by non-GDAL software.
GDAL may read internal GeoTIFF georeferencing or sidecars such as world files and TAB files.
GEOREF_SOURCES defines allowed georeferencing sources and their priority.
GeoTIFF exposes tiled/striped organization and block dimensions; tiled block sizes obey format constraints.
GeoTIFF compression method is explicit metadata/creation state and must be captured for reproducibility.
PREDICTOR selection is explicit for LZW/DEFLATE/ZSTD and differs for floating-point data.
UNORDERED_BLOCKS=YES may signal that physical block order differs from recommended order.
BLOCK_OFFSET_x_y metadata can identify physical offsets of TIFF blocks.
GeoTIFF 1.1 is selected automatically when encoding a CRS with a vertical component or 3D CRS.
gdal raster info reports driver, raster size, CRS and geotransform.
gdal raster info reports datatype, block size, nodata, overviews and unit type.
--approx-stats may use overviews or a subset of tiles and is not exact full-resolution evidence.
--checksum can compute a GDAL band checksum.
GDALChecksumImage is 16-bit and converts floating-point values to 32-bit integers, so decimal portions do not affect it.
Raster datasets are read at block level; block_shapes and block_windows expose native storage blocks.
Overviews are reduced-resolution representations and decimated reads may read them directly instead of full resolution.

integrity_policy.overview_policy: inventory_only; terminal extrema use native full-resolution pixels
integrity_policy.network_policy: bounded retries; explicit cache state; final URL and remote size recorded
